nodes.label: Hero as Thesis
nodes.rationale: Open the page with the most characteristic thing in the subject's world rather than a generic stat-and-gradient template, so the hero communicates a real thesis about the subject.

nodes.label: Typography Carries Personality
nodes.rationale: Pair display and body faces deliberately per-project rather than reusing default pairings, so type itself becomes a memorable part of the design instead of a neutral delivery vehicle.

nodes.label: Structure Is Information
nodes.rationale: Structural devices like numbering, eyebrows, and dividers should encode something true about the content (e.g. real sequence), not decorate it by default.

nodes.label: Deliberate Motion
nodes.rationale: Choose one orchestrated animation moment that serves the subject rather than scattering effects, since excess motion reads as AI-generated.

nodes.label: Match Complexity to Vision
nodes.rationale: Maximalist directions require elaborate execution, minimal directions require spacing/type precision; elegance is executing the chosen vision well.

nodes.label: AI-Generated Design Defaults (Three Looks)
nodes.rationale: Names the three visual clusters AI-generated design defaults to (cream/serif/terracotta; near-black/single accent; broadsheet hairline-rule layout) so they can be recognized and avoided unless the brief calls for them.

nodes.label: Design Process: Brainstorm, Explore, Plan, Critique, Build, Critique Again
nodes.rationale: A two-pass process: draft a compact token system (color/type/layout/signature), then review it against the brief for genericness before writing code.
nodes.norm_label: design process: brainstorm, explore, plan, critique, build, critique again

nodes.label: Restraint and Self-Critique
nodes.rationale: Spend boldness in one signature element, keep the rest quiet, and self-critique by removing an accessory before shipping (Chanel maxim), while still meeting a quality floor of responsiveness, focus states, and reduced-motion support.

nodes.label: Writing in Design Principles
nodes.rationale: Copy is design material: name things by what users control, use active voice, keep failure/empty states directive rather than apologetic, and keep register conversational and consistent.
